price_why: A home decorator would pay for a sourced trend read, a fully specced first post (gothic lace heart plus black buttercream carousel) and a dated Pinterest/Instagram calendar that includes the early Valentine's pin timing. It is mostly aggregated blog trends, and later posts are thinner, so $49 is too much.
one_line: A heavily researched, well-tailored content brief that leads with one clear hero post (gothic silver-lace vintage heart with black-buttercream carousel) and an 8-week seasonal calendar, with thinner specs on later posts.
strongest: The Post 1 spec: an exact cake design, reel shot order, two hook variants to test, and a companion black-buttercream carousel with concrete steps. It sits in a clear 'post this first' recommendation tied to the Halloween and Pinterest timing.
weakest: It is too much for one home baker (a reel, carousel, Story and 4–6 pins per cake over 8 weeks). Several later posts (rosette, Christmas, ruffles) lack a settled format, cover or hook. The rosette idea also rests on an equestrian-fashion search spike with unproven cake crossover, which the answer admits.
